steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Cartesian form: z = a + bi; Polar form: z = r(cos θ + i sin θ) = re^{iθ}

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Modulus |z| = sqrt(a^2+b^2); Argument arg(z) = arctan(b/a) (adjust for quadrant)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Conjugate: z̄ = a - bi = re^{-iθ}; Properties: z + z̄ = 2a, z z̄ = |z|^2

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: de Moivre: (cos θ + i sin θ)ⁿ = cos nθ + i sin nθ; (re^{iθ})ⁿ = rⁿe^{inθ}

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Solve z^3 = -8. Plot the roots on an Argand diagram and show they form an equilateral triangle --- Solution: z^3 = 8e^{ipi} -> z = 2e^{i(pi+2kpi)/3} for k=0,1,2. Roots: 2e^{ipi/3} = 1+isqrt3, 2e^{ipi} = -2, 2e^{i5pi/3} = 1-isqrt3. Distance between any two = sqrt((1-(-2))^2+(sqrt3-0)^2) = sqrt(9+3) = 2sqrt3 -- all equal, equilateral triangle

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Express (1+isqrt3)⁶ in polar form | Find all solutions to z⁴ = -16 | Solve z^2 + 4z + 13 = 0, plot roots
